1. Grape, taro paste, sea crab coffee, with milk and sugar
Motoko passed out cold after drinking this... Maybe it could be used as a sleeping pill in the future?

2. Potato, black pepper, Torment Eagles' tears latte art coffee, original flavor
Out of curiosity, I bought some Torment Eagles' tears at the supermarket. It seems much better suited as a salad dressing than in coffee.

...

7. Herring soup red bean paste coffee brewed with Wishpower powder, extra spicy
Motoko took a sip, gave a thumbs-up, and didn't say a word.

8. Himeko's special coffee, supposedly brewed with 19 secret ingredients
Motoko said she wanted to try making me a cup too, but this taste... I suspect she has what it takes to join the Doctors of Chaos.

9. Pineapple, pineapple, pineapple, pineapple, pineapple, pineapple coffee, original flavor
The universe is truly wondrous. To think there are so many completely different things called pineapples. Next time, I'll definitely collect 19 kinds of pineapples to brew a cup of coffee.

...

16. Stargrass flower magnetic flow coffee, with sugar
Rumor has it that the legendary navigator Granholm was quite fond of tea brewed from wind-dried stargrass flowers. But I must admit, even I thought this attempt was a complete failure.

17. Cumulous steak mung bean coffee, with milk and sugar
It tastes pretty good, though a little hard to swallow.

18. Tandilor Ring red dust candy coffee, original flavor
I brought my masterpiece to school as a treat for everyone, but the reception was... less than ideal.

...
